bullets.content: [general] REPEATED: submitted with solves unused in two generations. Use all 4 solves, changing one factor each; submit only after compare between the two best candidates.

[general] Plan all 4 solves in the first message as single-factor experiments (anchor on proven recipe, lean DOF variant, extra variant, combination). Compare to the finest anchor, never compare(a,a). After each solve run compare(anchor,new) and view error before next mesh; spend solve 4 on cheapest untested change. Submit by compare, energy per DOF, hotspots.

[general] After EVERY solve call view(solve=n, kind=error, view=-y or iso) and read top-5 hotspots: location, local h vs requested size, share. Place the next single change at the cluster. A box of 0.002 delivered 0.0024-0.0027 at the binding slab and was missed.

[general] Never change box size and box extent in the same solve; results can't be attributed. Change one factor per solve and state it before mesh(). Spend experiments on different levers (h, f2 radius, thin top box), not tiny box-size changes.
[general] After mesh(), read 'element size near each group' and quote touching h of every refined group before solving. Requested sizes land ~1.3x larger (f2 asked 0.0032, got 0.0035).
[general] A refinement adding <1% nodes (f2 r0.005->0.008 gave +49 nodes) is the cheapest experiment; solve it rather than discard it.
[general] Report only what tool outputs say (no unsupported claims like 'switched to meshadapt'). Attribute node changes to ±15% remeshing noise unless output states otherwise.

[general] Reference-free error estimate was ~1.4x optimistic (est 9.2% vs true 13.0%). Multiply self-estimates by ~1.4 before deciding the target is met; if above target and solves remain, refine at the hotspots.
[general] Do not discount a solve for odd 'applied load' totals in the printout; it is a reporting artefact. Judge by compare change, strain energy and DOFs.

[general] Compare between meshes differing by <3% DOFs (6.27% shown) is remeshing noise; true error was 8.17%. Rank such candidates by strain energy at similar DOFs. Use compare as error proxy only against a much finer anchor, then multiply by ~1.5.

[general] Above target base = g/(2c). A refinement pays only if its error drop % >= its DOF increase %. Reject any change adding >5% DOFs without a clear error drop (+1.2k DOFs for 0.1% energy is not worth it). Rough estimate; confirm with compare.

[general] Before submitting the finest solve, write base=g/(2c) for each candidate. +20% DOFs lowered base ~0.21 to 0.185 (estimate); hidden bonus not guaranteed. Submit the higher base unless bonus evidence is strong.

[general] Mesher and solver are deterministic: identical mesh call reproduces numbers exactly (e.g. 0.033980422791937 for all agents). Solve the anchor only as compare baseline, then spend every solve on a new single factor.

[general] Above target score ~ error/DOFs, so uniform refinement only breaks even. At 28k DOFs cost term was 0.214 vs accuracy 1.01. Raise h in low-error regions, keep local boxes on hotspots; aim ~15-18k DOFs.

[general] On 3D parts with many small features global h barely moves DOFs (h 0.008 gave median h 0.005; h 0.012 still 4681 nodes). Control DOFs with local refinements; check median h and node count before each solve.

[general] A refinement with size > global h is ignored (f15/f17/f25 at 0.007 on h 0.0045 gave identical 10192 nodes). To coarsen a region, raise global h and refine the rest, or shrink refinement extents.
[general] Min quality was 0.11 with edge-22 size 0.003 (limit 0.1). If a change lowers it, raise edge 22 to 0.0032 instead of changing h.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] a0 recipe at h 0.0045 (edge 40 and f2 0.003 r0.005, edges 39/8 0.0028 r0.004, junction boxes 0.003 r0.004): 15.2% field, 5.14% point error at 30.1k DOFs, rank 1; edge 40 + f2 kept top ring h 0.0037-0.0039.
[abc_00000003_bc7] a0 got 15.6% field at 28974 DOFs (base 0.214, best base) with h 0.0052, edges 39/8 0.0021, f19 0.0025 r0.004. Base recipe for variant; change only h.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Finer wall resolution wins hidden points: 36.8k mesh earned 0.1875 bonus vs a0's 0.0625; lower-wall hidden points were largest misses. h 0.0045 refines wall cheaply while a0 stays 0.0052, so ties unlikely.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Junction boxes at 0.003 gave local h 0.0035-0.0038 at hotspots #1/#2/#5/#6 (x≈±0.012-0.013, z 0.023-0.028, 11.8% energy). Never coarsen: 0.0036 cut DOFs 13% but energy 0.033980->0.033670, compare 12.6%. To go finer request 0.0026.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Junction boxes 0.0024 (z 0.020-0.034) cost +6.2k DOFs (+20%) for +0.51% energy, field 14.1%, base 0.185 vs 0.214. With f2 0.0026, 14.1% at 36.8k vs 15.2% at 30.1k: lower score. Submit ~30k recipe unless error <12%.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Edges 39/8 at 0.002 r0.005 vs 0.0028: +148 nodes, energy change negligible, compare 6.57% (noise). Hotspots sit 1-2 mm off edges; edge sizing is not the lever.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Top ring z≈0.056 held 18.1% of error energy at h 0.0034-0.0035 even with f2 0.0026 r0.008; hotspots 0.8-1.2 mm off f20 on outer wall. f2 below 0.0027 buys little. Untested: thin box [-0.02,-0.0185,0.052,0.02,0.0185,0.0613] 0.0028 r0.002 (top ring, P1).

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Keep {group:f2,size:0.003,radius:0.005} plus {edge:40,size:0.003,radius:0.005}. Top clamp band z≈0.056 (f20/f21) held 22.3% of error energy at h 0.0044; P1 was -40% vs -8% in a0.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Control tweak: f2 0.003 r0.005 -> {group:f2,size:0.0026,radius:0.008}, rest as a0 recipe. Top ring z≈0.056 holds 16.7% of error energy (hotspots #3/#4, h 0.0036-0.0038); f2 touching 0.00368. Expect touching ≤0.0032, P1 better than -10.4%, few % more DOFs.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Lean variant: a0 recipe, change ONLY h 0.0045->0.0055 (est. 26-27k DOFs, field ~16%). Accept only if compare to solve 1 ≤10%, min_quality≥0.1, f20 touching ≤0.0042.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Top box [-0.02,-0.0185,0.05,0.02,0.0185,0.0613] at 0.0028 r0.002 cut compare-to-46k 12.8%->11.2% for +6.6k DOFs. Works, but f2 refinement is cheaper.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Edge 40 at 0.0024 gave FEWER nodes (9990 vs 10046), min q 0.205, lower energy 0.033926. Edge 40 is not the top-ring lever; use f2 or a thin box z 0.051-0.0613 within r≈0.02 of axis.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Never coarsen tube wall beyond 0.005: h 0.012 with wall box 0.006 gave 21.4k DOFs, compare 15.8% (true ~19-20%, below target).

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Plugs f15/f17 (h 0.0075) and lower cylinder z<0.01 have near-zero error; keep coarse. Thin walls cap savings: median h stayed 0.0038 at h 0.01. DOF-cut test: f25 0.007 r0.003 plus f15/f17 at 0.007; accept only if energy drops <0.1%.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Untested: lower wall near f23 z 0.005-0.015 (spread 3.4%, h ~0.0038): box [-0.022,-0.018,0,0.022,0.018,0.012] size 0.0035 r0.003. Only after the f2 test.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Peer a1: h 0.0052 with f2 0.0027 r0.007 reached 16.1% at 27.2k DOFs (base 0.217 vs 0.211). Tighter f2 partly offsets coarser h.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Error is diffuse (top 20 cells ~58%, f20 touches 3249 elements); cheap local fixes largely exhausted. A real gain may need another lever (order or h), not more boxes.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Solve plan: (1) f2 0.0026 r0.008 control at h 0.0045; (2) h 0.0055 variant; (3) thin top box or f25/plug DOF cut; (4) best combo. compare each to the finest; submit cheapest within 1 point of best.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Variant plan: (1) next call at h 0.0045; (2) same at h 0.0048; (3) same at h 0.0040 if nodes <13k. Change only h; record energy vs DOFs. Submit (1) unless (3) gains >=15% energy-gap per 10% DOFs.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Setup (3d, E 210e9, nu 0.3, f2 fixed, 4e6 on f23, 2.1e6 on f16) is fine. Reuse unchanged; don't re-run a known mesh.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] True field error ≈1.23x compare vs a 46k-DOF reference (12.8% -> 15.8%). Use 1.25x when judging the 15.93% target.

[abc_00000003_bc7] View error after EVERY solve. Check whether lower wall z≈0.015 near f23 (cells ±x ~2.2-2.3% each) drops with h 0.0045; it is set by global h only. Hidden RMS 5.33%, worst (10%) near f23 z≈0.005; field error drives score.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Disclosed P1 (z 0.057, rim) is still -10.4%, worst check point; rim cells at z 0.056 show 150-240% local error. Thin box [-0.02,-0.0185,0.052,0.02,0.0185,0.0613] at 0.0026 r0.002 might fix both.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Energy ladder: 0.033980 (30.1k, 15.2%), 0.033926 (30.0k), 0.033770 (27.2k, 16.1%), 0.033712 (26.5k), 0.033670 (26.2k). Base flat ~0.211-0.217, so between near-equal bases submit the most accurate solve (won hidden-point bonus).

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Before accepting a DOF cut write the inequality: above target base ∝1/(error×DOFs); below 15.93% missing is quadratic. -13% DOFs vs est. +8% error was near break-even; calibrate with a1's 27.2k/16.1% point.
